3486730.title: Gyeonggi Rice Gimbap Festa
3486730.overview: A gimbap expo built on Gyeonggi-grown rice: a national gimbap cooking contest, tastings, exhibitions, and sales booths — Korea's everyday seaweed roll given a whole convention hall.

531391.title: Gangneung Danoje Festival
531391.overview: A UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity with a thousand years behind it: eight days of Confucian rites, all-night shamanic gut ceremonies where gods and people meet, and Korea's largest open-air market — 71 programs across 13 fields drawing over half a million visitors. This year's theme, 'unraveling', centers Dano's oldest promise: let worries loosen and relationships come untied.

4071535.title: Rural Travel Festival
4071535.overview: A one-day 'countryside vacation in Seoul' on Seoul Plaza for Urban-Rural Exchange Day: farm-stay and rural-tourism booths, healing-farm and forest-trail showcases, and young rural-travel startups pitching offbeat countryside itineraries to city dwellers.
4071535.sponsor: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs

3491755.title: Seoul Food Show (K-Food Show)
3491755.overview: A food-industry expo at the aT Center themed 'K-Street Food, To Global Tables': Korea's beloved bunsik snack culture as global content, with food trucks, tasting programs, and new-product showcases aimed at teens through thirty-somethings.

3494070.title: Jinju Garden Expo
3494070.overview: Marking its new provincial-garden designation, Jinju opens the forests of Wolasan for a citizen garden expo — 'tend, feel, share': garden art exhibitions, healing programs, and cultural events among the trees of 'the pearl in the Wolasan woods'.

3114721.title: Gangwon Hanwoo Day
3114721.overview: Gangwon's premium hanwoo beef takes over Chuncheon's city-hall plaza: discounted sales direct from producer co-ops, free grilled tastings, gifts for buyers, kids' shows, and a flea market — a city-center beef festival connecting farms and tables.

2616325.title: Seoul Gugak Festival
2616325.overview: Korean traditional music on the Han River: master-musician stages, participatory madang, hands-on heritage programs and one-day classes at Banpo's Moonlight Plaza — gugak crossing from tradition into the trendy, free by the water.

141963.title: Daegu International Musical Festival (DIMF)
141963.overview: Asia's musical-theater festival turns 20: official invited productions from abroad (many never staged in Korea), premieres of supported new Korean musicals, a university musical festival, and audition programs — the global art market that made Daegu Korea's musical city.
141963.place: Daegu Arts Center and theaters citywide
141963.fee: Varies by show — see official site

3113022.title: Craft Week Korea
3113022.overview: Ten days of craft across the whole country, anchored this year in Buyeo with five regional clusters (Sejong–Gongju, Jeonju–Gochang, Chilgok–Gumi, Ulsan–Busan, Jeju–Seogwipo): exhibitions, workshops, markets, and craft tours letting handwork seep into daily life since 2018.
3113022.place: Buyeo hub city and venues nationwide
3113022.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

4069908.title: Chuncheon Mini Sool Festa
4069908.overview: Sixteen Chuncheon breweries pour traditional sool at the Hwadong 2571 complex: tasting and bottle-sale booths, food pairings from local F&B brands, brewing-salon lectures, 'fermentation yoga', a drinking book club, and a media exhibition — a compact local liquor culture festival.

1007868.title: Busan Port Festival
1007868.overview: Busan's harbor celebrates itself: fireworks over Busan Harbor Bridge, daytime water-leisure programs on the waterways, port tours, and maritime-culture experiences around the North Port waterfront park — the working port's history made festival.

2611559.title: Gimpo Ara Marine Festival
2611559.overview: The capital region's only inland marina throws its summer festival: kayaking, SUP, and water-bike sessions on the Ara waterway, dinghy races, an opening concert, food trucks, and a local market — marine leisure made easy an hour from Seoul.

3334712.title: Hoengseong Summer Night Festa
3334712.overview: A 'night picnic' on the Seomgang riverbanks: daytime water activities flowing into evening acoustic stages, food zones, rest lounges, and photo spots — a stay-all-day night-tourism festival in Hoengseong's clear river country.

2381291.title: Yangsan Ungsang Hoeya Festival
2381291.overview: The Ungsang district's festival of its Ubul shrine and rain-rite legends: a citizens' military-band parade re-enacting the Joseon Tongsinsa envoy processions, the local Nongcheong Jangwon folk-play, and the signature 'Ungsang Water Festa' — the old rain prayer reborn as a summer water performance.

2952109.title: Yonggol Dance Festa
2952109.overview: Yongdusan Park — 'Yonggol', birthplace of Korea's 90s dance boom and a shrine of world b-boy culture — hosts a youth dance-battle festival: any genre, any teen dancer can take the stage, with events and food stalls around the competition.

4074598.title: Choansan Hydrangea Festival
4074598.overview: Ten thousand hydrangeas of 17 varieties on a restored hillside in northern Seoul: night lighting, picnic decks, an ecological pond and waterfall, plus two days of food trucks and concerts (including Jang Sa-ik and orchestra stages). Public transit recommended — no on-site parking.

3488940.title: MyK FESTA
3488940.overview: A four-day K-culture mega-event at KINTEX: top-tier K-pop stages (MyK Live), talk sessions with K-content icons (MyK Voice), brand pop-ups and showcases (MyK Street), and a B2B export fair (MyK Trade) — the industry and its global fans in one place.
3488940.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

2550263.title: Semiwon Lotus Culture Festival
2550263.overview: Semiwon — a water-and-flower garden wrapped on three sides by Paldang Lake, Gyeonggi's first designated provincial garden — celebrates its lotus season: 270 plant species, traditional Eastern garden courts, exhibitions and performances timed to the blooms, on ground where the Joseon scholar Jeong Yak-yong once bridged the Han with boats.

3304617.title: Gangjin Hydrangea Road Festival
3304617.overview: Eight kilometers of hydrangea path winding up Boeunsan past the temples of Goseongsa and Geumgoksa: locally grown blooms line the trail, with performances, hands-on programs, and farm-product markets at the V-Land park below — 'Beautiful hydrangea, beautiful Gangjin'.

1032770.title: Busan International Magic Festival
1032770.overview: The world's largest magic festival, running since 2006: a magic convention, the international busking championship, and gala shows at Busan Cinema Center and Haeundae Beach — the dream stage of Korea's million magic fans.

1302214.title: Muan Lotus Festival
1302214.overview: Korea's largest lotus festival at Hoesan Baekryeonji — 100,000 pyeong, the East's biggest white-lotus pond, blooming since 1997: white lotus rising through a sea of green leaves, with lotus-themed programs, performances, and exhibitions in the far southwest.

2719122.title: Busan Food Film Festa
2719122.overview: Food meets film for a 10th year under the Busan Cinema Center's colossal Big Roof: a 2,000-seat outdoor cinema with nightly shows, the signature Food Terrace pairing noodle films with expert-led tastings, trendy food and coffee stalls, flea markets, and pizza-making for families.

3495841.title: Come to the Forest
3495841.overview: A family eco-festival on Jeju's forests: expert-guided forest expeditions ('Environment Guardians'), three-generation family programs, kids' flea markets, choir and nonverbal performances, character parades, and nature-play zones teaching conservation by doing.

3497502.title: Gyeongsan Cafe Festival
3497502.overview: A night-time cafe festival on the Namcheon riverbanks: a 'starlight night cafe' grand opening, limited-edition desserts fusing Gyeongsan's shinbi peaches with local specialty coffee, and a following week of orchestra and choir tours through 20 cafes across the city.

1841539.title: MATO Arts Festival
1841539.overview: 'Last-Saturday arts festival' in Anjeong-ri, the arts village by Camp Humphreys: June's edition is 'Summer Christ-MATO' — Christmas in high summer with water pools, air bounces, snow-bubble play, performances, pet programs, and photo zones on the artists' plaza.

1829696.title: ASYAAF 100
1829696.overview: The gateway art fair for Asia's young artists, now in its 19th year: 100 selected artists aged 19–39 show some 300 works at Art Chosun Space in two rotations, with visitor votes picking ten winners — where collectors meet future masters first.

574047.title: Buyeo Seodong Lotus Festival
574047.overview: Ten million lotus blooms on Gungnamji — Korea's oldest artificial pond, built by Baekje's King Mu, whose love story with Princess Seonhwa names the festival: lotus paths by day, illuminated pond magic by night, with performances, family programs, and Baekje's garden heritage all around.

2607445.title: Gangneung Beach Beer Festival
2607445.overview: Craft beer on Gyeongpo Beach as the swimming season opens: a Blue Wave zone with stage shows, beer olympics, water-gun battles and EDM nights, and a Green Wave zone of pine-forest lounging and busking — brews from across the country plus Gangneung local food.

3035057.title: 9.81 Park Dog Festival
3035057.overview: A dogs-and-owners travel program at 9.81 Park in Jeju's Aewol hills: walks and activities through the greenery with coaching from celebrity vet Seol Chae-hyun and professional trainers — the dog-friendly Jeju trip, organized.

2375382.title: Daegu Apsan Festival
2375382.overview: Apsan — the healing mountain in the middle of Korea's hottest city — cools off its July: water-cannon games and family water-gun battles, a dress-code event rewarding loud aloha shirts with cool towels, stamp tours, and hand-drip and latte-art workshops tied to the Apsan coffee street.

4076709.title: Stationery Fair Summer
4076709.overview: A fancy-goods and illustration fair at the aT Center: independent creators and brands selling stationery, fancy products, and illustration work to Korea's devoted stationery-collector crowd.

3499540.title: Yangpyeong Watermelon Festival
3499540.overview: Three Ws — watermelon, water, wellness: Cheongun's high-sugar, crisp watermelons (big day-night temperature swings do the work) star in tastings, contests, and watermelon foods, with kids' water play and family programs at the Yongdu folk market.

3302702.title: Korea Petcance
3302702.overview: A pet expo at Gumico for the age of 15 million pet owners: spaces for dogs, cats, reptiles, and amphibians alike, adoption campaigns for rescued animals, and pet-industry booths — a vacation fair for the whole multi-species family.

1951053.title: Ulsan 119 Safety Culture Festival
1951053.overview: Learn survival by playing: 93 programs across five themed zones at Ulsan's convention center — fire-escape and earthquake simulations, CPR training, firefighting robots and VR, and firefighter-for-a-day experiences for all ages.

1824778.title: Tongyeong Theatre Arts Festival
1824778.overview: Ten days of theater in the port city of artists: the 18th edition, themed empathy and connection, stages new works and contemporary reinterpretations where Tongyeong's memories and world narratives cross — the south coast's flagship performing-arts festival.
1824778.place: Tongyeong Citizens' Culture Center and citywide

2719507.title: Geumsan Samgyetang Festival
2719507.overview: Korea's first festival for its great summer restorative — samgyetang, ginseng chicken soup — in the ginseng capital itself: hearty bowls loaded with real Geumsan ginseng, modern ginseng-chicken snacks for younger tastes, herbal health programs, family water play, and night stages against the summer heat.

3487396.title: Chilgok Honey Beer Festival
3487396.overview: Beer brewed with honey from Korea's largest acacia forests, and German-style sausages made by Benedictine monks at Waegwan Abbey: Chilgok's odd-couple festival adds honey crafts, water slides and water-gun play, balloon shows, and local stages at the Peace Fountain.

2826964.title: Groove in Gwanak
2826964.overview: Seoul's street-dance battle festival, five years in and linked to Japan's World Dance Colosseum: popping, locking, waacking, breaking, house, and krump crews compete for a 7-million-won purse along Sillim's starlight stream — a ministry-award-winning youth culture festival.

1825520.title: Gyeonggi Puppet Festival in Suwon
1825520.overview: Twenty-four years of puppetry: seven days of Korean and international companies — including Czech troupe Dazuma — performing across the Gyeonggi Arts Center's stages, a genre-spanning festival for audiences of every age.

2387785.title: Board Game Con
2387785.overview: Korea's board-game convention at COEX: open play tables for all ages, tournaments, a designers' zone, and industry booths — hands-on tabletop gaming backed by the culture ministry and KOCCA.
2387785.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism · KOCCA

3495394.title: Jeonju Chaekkwae Indie Book Fair
3495394.overview: Named for Joseon's itinerant book peddlers: independent publishers, creators, and bookshops from across the country selling new titles at Jeonju's culture warehouse quarter, with lectures, exhibitions, and events for the book-loving city.

4086427.title: Chuncheon Summer Water Festival
4086427.overview: A lakeside water park festival at Chuncheon's waterfront: main, lazy-river, and toddler pools, a 30m mega-slide, and the new challenge-bounce obstacle escape — family water play in the lake city, Thursday through Sunday.

142228.title: Taebaek Sunflower Festival
142228.overview: A purely private-run festival painting the highland canvas of Guwau village sunflower-yellow: fields at 800m elevation, artists' installations among the blooms, and a philosophy of quiet healing over commerce — one of Korea's most contemplative flower festivals.

4088257.title: Life Bookstore Book Fair
4088257.overview: Thirty-six local bookshops from across Korea gather in Jeonju under the slogan 'keep reading and it becomes your life': each shop brings its own character and life-book curations picked by the owners, with reading programs for every stage of life.
4088257.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

2989580.title: Jangsu Cool Valley Festival
2989580.overview: A mountain-valley summer escape at Banghwadong recreation forest: swimming pools and water slides beside a clear natural stream, valley-night concerts, family programs, and Jangsu farm-food stalls deep in the cool of Jeonbuk's highlands.

140833.title: Hongcheon Waxy Corn Festival
140833.overview: The 30th festival of Korea's corn capital: Hongcheon hosts the nation's only corn research institute and supplies 78% of its seed corn, and its big day-night temperature swings give the chalok (waxy corn) its sweetness and chew — taste the difference at the Tori Forest park.

3352452.title: Comic World Summer
3352452.overview: Korea's flagship amateur comics convention at KINTEX: fan-made zines, fancy goods, and illustration circles selling direct, gacha lotteries and stamp events, best-zine voting, and the cosplay stage where dance, song, and performance close the day.

4079965.title: Dalseong Water Splash
4079965.overview: Daegu's first municipal water festival, back for round two at the Gangjeong-bo ARC plaza: young local performers plus special-guest stages, water-splash sessions against the 'Daefrica' heat, youth markets, and startup food trucks by the river.

3509884.title: Seoul Summer Beach
3509884.overview: A beach in the middle of Gwanghwamun: pools, water slides, water buckets and bounce pools in the Water Play zone, a sand hideout and rest lounges in the Play Wave zone, plus flea markets and food trucks — 'Wave Summer, Play Seoul', free downtown.
3509884.sponsor: Seoul Metropolitan Government · Seoul Tourism Organization

4055637.title: K-Heritage House
4055637.overview: Marking the 48th UNESCO World Heritage Committee session in Busan: all 17 of Korea's World Heritage sites in one exhibition, Memory of the World displays, heritage media art, royal gate-guard ceremonies, living-heritage craft demonstrations, and a K-goods shop at BEXCO.

2543724.title: Myeongju Puppet Festival
2543724.overview: Gangneung's beloved family puppet festival since 2014: hand puppets, paper-cup theater, puppet musicals, and shadow plays at the Myeongju arts yard — carefully selected productions with real storytelling that outgrow the 'kids only' label, drawing 10,000 visitors a year.

3318880.title: Jeju Rural Convergence Industry Expo
3318880.overview: An agri-food-tech expo at Jeju's international convention center: this year's theme pairs food tech with AI robotics, alongside producer-consumer markets, export trade meetings, and an international forum on rural convergence industries.

4077756.title: Sanhwabi: HEXAGRAM 22
4077756.overview: A special performance for the UNESCO World Heritage Committee session: artists who wrestle tradition into the present day put Korea's intangible heritage on the BEXCO auditorium stage — tradition and contemporaneity colliding, reconciling, and breathing together. Free.

2486085.title: Busan Wartime Capital Heritage Night
2486085.overview: 'Walk the emotional heritage of the city of memory': Busan's 1950s wartime-capital sites open after dark — a media facade on Yeongdo Bridge, a pop-up museum of postwar daily life, young artists' showcases at the old Mildawon teahouse site, and AR stamp tours across 20 programs in 8 night themes.
2486085.place: Yeongdo Bridge (Yurari Plaza) and wartime-capital sites
2486085.sponsor: Korea Heritage Service · Busan Metropolitan City

1831344.title: Pyeongchang Heat Hunting Festival
1831344.overview: Ttamtti Park's spring water holds 10°C all year, and Pyeongchang built its summer festival on it: the water battle between the heat-ghost and the guardian spirit, giant water cannons, night camping under mountain skies, and cold makguksu noodles when you climb out shivering.

2728613.title: Gwimong at Jeju Shinhwa World
2728613.overview: An outdoor horror night at Jeju Shinhwa World's theme park: a fright course through real darkened terrain, b-boy and horror-musical performances, ghost-edition rides (spinning coaster, carousel), and a 'gwimong market' of spooky pubs, makeup shops, and food. 30,000 won, gates from 19:00.
2728613.place: Shinhwa Theme Park, Jeju Shinhwa World

3507102.title: Dudu Summer Dong (Daegu Dong-gu Summer Festival)
3507102.overview: Dong-gu's answer to the 'Daefrica' heat on the Geumho riverside: water-bomb concerts, water survival games, dance contests, craft-beer pubs, and flea markets — young energy and river breezes at the Jijeo waterfront.

2499947.title: Seongbuk Culture Vacance
2499947.overview: Seongbuk's 10th urban water-play festival: exciting slides and mom-and-baby pools at a schoolyard and the Uicheon stream plaza, with magic shows, K-pop dance, drumming performances, and water-gun and bubble programs. Seongbuk residents free; others 2,000 won.

142064.title: Bonghwa Sweetfish Festival
142064.overview: Catch your dinner in the Naeseongcheon: net-fishing and bare-hand sweetfish (eun-eo) catching in the clear shallows, ayu dishes to try afterward, water play, performances, and full summer amenities — Bonghwa's participatory eco-festival.

4081268.title: Hongcheon Esports Festival
4081268.overview: A family gaming festival at Hongcheon's gymnasium: four-title amateur tournaments with a 20-million-won prize pool — Korea's biggest for amateurs — plus VR, drone, and game experience zones, cosplay, esports coaching, and career counseling.
